name: chief-of-staff
description: Your AI chief of staff for Claude and Cowork. Sweeps email, calendar and other sources every two hours and keeps an append-only registry in Google Drive, OneDrive, SharePoint or a local folder — what needs you now, decisions waiting, open loops — plus morning briefs, meeting prep and weekly reviews. Read-only on your sources.

interface.shortDescription: Keeps you on top of email, calendar and chat
interface.longDescription: Chief of Staff watches your email, calendar and other sources on a schedule and keeps an append-only registry in your own Google Drive, OneDrive, SharePoint or local folder: what needs you now, decisions waiting, today's meetings with context and open loops. It writes morning briefs, preps you for meetings and runs a weekly review. It only reads your sources — it never sends, replies to, archives, deletes or shares anything.
defaultPrompt: Set up my chief of staff
Run radar: what did I miss?
